title: Directional Fineness for Radiant and Co-Radiant Sets: Separation and Quantitative Approximation
summary: A prescribed directionally fine family of cones yields separation and primal bipolar identities for closed radiant and co-radiant sets in real normed spaces. Positive levels of adapted positively homogeneous functions separate points from closed radiant sets, while a correction by the norm provides bounded radiant neighbourhoods for co-radiant separation. The resulting classes also calibrate radial thresholds and represent gauges and cogauges through strict separators.
